components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, #2f5e34); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef); font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary, #2f5e34), inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef) 45%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary, #2f5e34) 85%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--color-card, #faf7ef); color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #8c8268); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-card, #faf7ef), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--color-border, #d3c8ae); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--color-border, #d3c8ae); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Chips
components.description: Single-choice chips with an Other field; selected turns leaf green.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; } .ds-chip { height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #8c8268); background: var(--color-card, #faf7ef); color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-card, #faf7ef), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--color-border, #d3c8ae); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--color-primary, #2f5e34); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary, #2f5e34), inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef) 45%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-input { height: 2.75rem; width: 9rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; font: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #8c8268); border-radius: 0.3rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); caret-color: var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); } .ds-chip-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-ring, #2f5e34) 50%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 0.25rem; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 3px double var(--color-input, #8c8268); } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #57544c); padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.225rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background: var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc); color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { color: var(--color-primary, #2f5e34); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.35em; }

components.name: Zone Plate
components.description: Arch-topped Storm to Sun plate split into upper and lower half buttons; a tapped half stays lit.
components.html: Sun
components.css: .ds-plate-wrap { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 6.5rem; } .ds-plate { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px 9999px 0 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #8c8268); background: var(--color-card, #faf7ef); outline: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d3c8ae); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-half { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.125rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem; background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 300ms ease-out; outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-half span { font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #57544c); } .ds-upper { min-height: 7rem; padding-top: 1rem; } .ds-lower { min-height: 3.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-input, #8c8268); } .ds-half:hover { background: var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc); } .ds-half[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--color-primary, #2f5e34); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef); } .ds-half[aria-pressed=true] span { color: inherit; } .ds-half:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); } .ds-zone { margin-top: 0.625rem; font-family: 'Alegreya Sans SC', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); }

components.css: .ds-row { padding: 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d3c8ae); max-width: 22rem; } .ds-row-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-name { font-weight: 500; } .ds-stage { display: block; font-family: 'Alegreya Variable', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--color-stage-seed, #7a5a1e); } .ds-progress { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #57544c); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-cell { height: 2.75rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, #8c8268); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, #1d1c19); cursor: pointer; } .ds-cell:hover { background: var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc); } .ds-done { background: var(--color-primary, #2f5e34); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary, #2f5e34), inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary-foreground, #faf7ef) 45%, transparent); } .ds-missed { background: var(--color-muted, #e7dfcc); color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #57544c); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #2f5e34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-notdue { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #57544c); }

narrative.overview:
Every screen is one engraved plate from a naturalist's folio. A cream ground carries sepia hairline rules and fruit-black ink. Leaf green is the only colour that says "this is chosen" or "this is done". Scarlet appears in one place only: a weed over its ceiling.

The plate is calm and quiet, built for a phone and for low capacity. Structure comes from rules and frames, not from cards or shadows. Headings are set in Alegreya italic, like a plate caption. Running text is Alegreya Sans. Small labels on controls are Alegreya Sans SC. Imagery is line engraving: hatching and cross-hatching stand in for tone.

At night the plate turns to pressed-leaf green-black with cream ink. Night follows the device setting only (`userInterfaceStyle: automatic`); there is no manual toggle.

The world rejects the wellness stack of rounded cards and emoji faces, and the wide spreadsheet tracker.
keyCharacteristics: Cream plate, sepia rules, fruit-black ink.
Leaf green marks done and selected; scarlet marks only a weed over its ceiling.
Italic serif headings, humanist sans text, small-caps labels.
Arch-topped frames and engraved line art, never filled illustration.
Flat: depth comes from inner hairlines and offset outlines, not drop shadows.

rules.name: The One Green Voice Rule
rules.body: Leaf green means selected, done, today or a link. Never use it for decoration.

rules.name: The Single Red Rule
rules.body: Scarlet marks only a weed over its ceiling and destructive actions. A logged weed day is plain ink; a missed day is neutral tint.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Headings are always Alegreya italic. Never set a heading in the sans or in small caps.

rules.name: The Small Caps Labels Controls Rule
rules.body: Small caps name a control or a column: a button, a tab, a day, a zone. They never float above a heading as a decorative label.

rules.name: The Engraved Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Show depth with doubled lines. Never add a blur shadow, an offset drop shadow or Android elevation.

rules.name: The Arch Rule
rules.body: The arch frames a Storm to Sun zone. It is the system's signature silhouette; reuse it for zone-like specimens, not for generic cards.

dos: Do open each section with the engraved double rule (3px double, sepia edge).
Do set every heading in Alegreya italic and every control label in Alegreya Sans SC.
Do keep every tap target at least 2.75rem (44px) tall.
Do draw icons and illustration as thin line engravings in the current text colour, with hatching for tone.
Do give every light colour token a night twin under `@variant dark` in `tokens.css`.
Do use the shadcn token classes (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`), never raw hex in components.
donts: Don't use scarlet for anything except a weed over its ceiling or a destructive action.
Don't use leaf green as decoration; it means selected, done, today or a link.
Don't add blur shadows, offset drop shadows or Android elevation; depth is doubled hairlines.
Don't use rounded wellness cards, emoji faces or filled illustrations.
Don't let the seven-day strip scroll sideways or grow into a wide spreadsheet.
Don't put small-caps labels above headings as decoration.
